game.title: Call of Duty: WWII
game.blurb: First-person shooter from Sledgehammer Games, released 2017-11-03. RAWG average playtime: 6 hours. Genres: Action, Shooter. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Campaign
chapters.summary: The hidden mission milestones and finishing the campaign. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Mission Challenges
chapters.summary: One-off goals inside named missions, such as the seawall, Operation Cobra, Stronghold, S.O.E., Liberation, Death Factory, Hill 493, Ambush and The Rhine.

chapters.title: Squad and Combat
chapters.summary: Asking each squad mate for supplies, saving and dragging allies, grenades, smoke and taking surrenders.

chapters.title: Mementos, Focus and Veteran
chapters.summary: All 33 mementos, time spent in Focus, and finishing on Veteran.

notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). Steam app 476600. StrategyWiki has a stub page (completion stage 0) that links Walkthrough, Gameplay and Table of Contents subpages, but none of them is written, so nothing was used. callofduty.fandom.com has the page, with 500 linked pages returned (the API limit, so likely more); names only were looked at, nothing copied. 10 of 35 Steam achievements are hidden; their names read like mission names and they sit in the campaign chapter. All 35 achievements are for the campaign: none covers multiplayer or any other mode, so there is no chapter for those. "Flyboy" (protect the bombers) does not name its mission; it sits with the mission challenges.
